trastuzumab-induced cardiotoxicity in elderly women is associated with the presence of cardiovascular risk factors and the use of concomitant chemotherapy.

1) the prevalence of cardiotoxicity is high in the elderly, and 2) cardiotoxicity in this group is related to the number of cardiovascular risk factors and not to the presence of cardiovascular comorbidity.
The incidence and severity of trastuzumab-induced cardiotoxicity in older adults are similar to those in younger adults.
